info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to anoint, to polish, to smear

entries.artha_hindi: tela malanA, mAna karanA, ekatra karanA

examples: 'pra SarDAya mArutAya svaBAnava imAM vAcamanajA' (f0 5.54.1). prAnaja=prANkta=prApayata.
'prAYjanAt uta parRaDeH' (aTarva0 4.6.5). prAYjanAt pralepAt.
'aYjate vyaYjate samajate' (aTarva॰18.3.18). samaYjate=samaYjanti samyag aYjanti.
'devAnyajantAvftuTA samaYjataH' (f॰2.3.7).
'samajantu viSvedevAH samApo hfdayAni nO' (f॰10.85.47). samaYjantu=saMyuYjantu =sampfYcantu.
'asmA idu saptimiva SravasyendrAyArkaM juhvA samaYje' (f॰1.61.5, aTarva॰20.35.5). samaYje=saNgataM karomi.

'aYjate vyaYjate kratuM rihanti laGunA'ByaYjate' (aTarva0 18.3.18). vyaYjate=vyaYjanti. lOkikAdaYjanAdanyena prakAregAYjantItyarTaH. taTA ca tEttirIyiRa Amananti--dakziRaM pUrvamANkte. savyaM hi pUrvaM manuzyA AYjata' (tE0 saM0 6.1.1.6) iti.
'SuBrA (marutaH) vyaYjata Sriye' (f0 8.7.25). vyaYjata=prAkASanta, adIpyanta.
'jihvA kaTaM te hfdayaM vyanakti' (BA0 saBA0 64.2). vyanakti, vyaktI karoti, vivfRoti, pratyakzayati.
'dEvamAnuzayoradya vyaktA vyaktirBavizyati' (rA0 2.23.18). vyaktirBedaH, prabaladurbalaviveka ityarTaH.
'lagno'gniScAmarezu prakAmaM vyajyate na sma sEnyEH' (SiSu0 18.34). na vyajyate sma na vivicyate sma, na vivicya jYAyate sma.
'vikrameRa ca vAkyESca vyaktiM vAM nopalakzaye' (rA0 4.12.31). vyaktirBedaH.
'vyaktiM BajantyApagAH' (SA0 7.8). vyaktiM Bajanti dfSyatAM yAnti, sPuwadarSanatAM gacCanti.
'vyaYjanamAtraM tattasyABiDAnasya Bavati' (ni0 7.13). vyaYjanaM viSezaRam.
'A no daDikAH paTyAmanaktu' (f0 7.44.5). Anaktu mrakzayatu SoDayatu mArzwu samI karotu.
'A vAM nakzanto adraya AYjan' (f0 6.63.3). satkAreRa pratIcCanti, sabahumAnaM pratigfhRanti.
'akziRI AYjya' (ASva0 gf0 4.6). akte kftvetyAha.
'yaTA makzA idaM maDu nyaYjanti maDAvaDi' (aTarva0 9.1.17). nyaYjanti nilimpanti.
'tvazwA gnAsvantarnyAnaje' (f0 1.161.4). nyAnaje=antarviveSa, antardave.
'meDAM me vizRurnyanaktvAsan' (aTarva0 18.3.11). nyanaktu saMyojayatu. Asani muKe.
'praticIna ANgiraso'Dyakto naH purohitaH' (aTarva0 10.1.6). aDyaktaH sajjaH sannadDaH. aDyakza iti pAWAntaram.
'aYjate vyaYjate samaYjate kratuM rihanti maDunA ByaYjate' (aTarva0 18.3.18). aByaYjate navanItena mADuryopetenAByaktaSarIraM kurvantItyarTaH.
'navanItenAByaYjanti.' (E0 brA0 1.3). aByaYjanti mrakzayanti, anulimpanti.
'aYjAno ajarEraBi' (f0 2.8.4). ukto'rTaH.
'BArasyodvahanArTaM ca raTAkzo'Byajyate yaTA' (sOndara0 14.12). aByajyate upasnihyate.
'akto'Byakto vezwityupavezwitI' (Apa0 Da0 1.8.2). akto'YjanenAkzRoraByaktastElena. vezwitI vezwitaSirAH. kawipradeSo dvitIyena vAsasA vezwito yasya sa upavezwitI.
'pratyanakttyavadAnAni' (Sa0 brA0 5.1.3.6).
'narASaMsaH prati DAmAnyaYjan' (f0 2.3.2).
'sruveRa kapAlAni pratyajya' (Apa0 SrO0 2.3.11.3). kapAlAni pratyekam aNktvA mrakzayitvA.
'uparizwAdaByajyADastAdupAnakti' (Apa0 SrO0 2.3.11.4). upAnakti mrakzayati upalimpati upadegDi. leperTe upena DAtoH sAhacaryamitIdampara upasargayogo'rTe tu viSezaM na karoti.
'yaTA'kzo'nupAktaH' (tE0 saM0 2.6.3.3). anupAkta upAYjanarahitaH.
'saMmArjanopAYjanena sekenolleKanena ca. gavAM ca parivAsena BUmiH SuDyati paYcaBiH' (manu0 5.124).. upAYjanamupalepaH.
